0022600120.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (1-1) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0) with Cleveland sitting 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, and 8th in the East, while Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West. The Cavaliers are 1-0 at home and 1-1 over their last ten games, currently on a W1 streak, while the Timberwolves are 2-0 on the road and riding a W2 streak. Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Cleveland winning their last meeting 146-134 in Cleveland on January 10, 2026.
